actions.name: Use
actions.area: allies within a 30-ft.-radius centered on you

description.summary: You call forth Carbuncle, an aeon with a crimson jewel shining from its forehead who enchants allies with Reflect status
description.value: You call forth Carbuncle, an aeon with a crimson jewel shining from its forehead who enchants allies with Reflect status. Allies within the area of effect are enchanted with a magical shield that deflects the next spell targeted them back at its caster, and is then discharged.
